A has the porcelain handle and the softer finish of the real cards, while B's glossy gold handle makes it look more like a polished statue.
B is built like a real porcelain cup, with a blue handle and slim gold trim; A's all-gold handle and stronger highlights look too glossy.
A's handle is porcelain-blue with gold edging, which reads as a real object and comes closer to the smooth, clean finish of the real cards than B's shiny gold handle.
The two are nearly the same; A's simpler handle and slightly cleaner, less fussy finish match the real cards a little better than B's thicker gold trim.
